name: transitops-hackathon
description: Root task runner for TransitOps — wraps docker/db, backend (FastAPI+uv), and frontend (Next.js) so everything can be driven with `npm run <script>` from the repo root.

scripts.docker:up: sg docker -c 'docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d db'
scripts.docker:logs: sg docker -c 'docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml logs -f db'
scripts.be: cd backend && uv run uvicorn transitops.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.be:migrate: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.be:seed: cd backend && uv run python -m transitops.seed
